note: UI-configurable per-tenant + per-FUNCTION MEDIUM selection. A client connects their preferred mediums (compute backend, LLM lane, search provider) and can set DIFFERENT mediums for DIFFERENT functions (e.g. extraction on Cloudflare, enrichment on Ollama). Resolved by _repos/teleon/backend/src/teleon/config/medium_resolver.py, which validates ids against the LIVE registries (no-magic-values) and reuses the objective/OIPS selectors + compute_ownership. Secrets are tenant SecretRefs (never inline). Edited from the config UI (dist/teleon-config/index.html). serves_truth=false.
resolution_order: tenant.per_function[function]  ->  tenant.per_function[default]  ->  global defaults (most specific wins)

medium_kinds.compute: where a capability unit RUNS (execution_backend_policy_matrix.backends_enum, + compute_ownership)
medium_kinds.llm: which model lane improves/runs the LLM step (cloudflare_workers_ai | ollama | openrouter | a lowcost lane)
